samples.rtl:
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    input  ground,
    input  dig,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right,
    output reg aaah,
    output reg digging
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: next_state = (ground && !bump_left && !bump_right && !dig) ? 2'b00 :
                                (ground && !bump_left && !bump_right && dig) ? 2'b10 :
                                (ground && !bump_left && bump_right) ? 2'b01 :
                                (ground && bump_left && !bump_right) ? 2'b01 :
                                2'b00;
            2'b01: next_state = (ground && !bump_left && !bump_right && !dig) ? 2'b01 :
                                (ground && !bump_left && !bump_right && dig) ? 2'b10 :
                                (ground && !bump_left && bump_right) ? 2'b01 :
                                (ground && bump_left && !bump_right) ? 2'b01 :
                                2'b01;
            2'b10: next_state = (ground && !bump_left && !bump_right && !dig) ? 2'b10 :
                                (ground && !bump_left && !bump_right && dig) ? 2'b10 :
                                (ground && !bump_left && bump_right) ? 2'b00 :
                                (ground && bump_left && !bump_right) ? 2'b00 :
                                2'b10;
            default: next_state = 2'b00;
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        walk_left = (state == 2'b00);
        walk_right = (state == 2'b01);
        aaah = (state == 2'b10);
        digging = (state == 2'b10 && dig);
    end
endmodule
